description: Change quantity, material, production speed or delivery, and reprice. This expires any open checkout link for the quote and its build, permanently, so tell the customer first. Then show the new price and get approval again before a new checkout. Paid or authorized quotes can't change. Never charges, refunds or starts manufacturing.

accessToken.description: Guest token from printing.sessions.start. Omit when it is sent as a Bearer header.

fulfillmentMethod.description: US shipping, SoMa pickup or Bay Area courier.

materialId.description: Material ID from printing.capabilities.get. Defaults to black_pla. Changing it reprices the quote and needs fresh approval.
